images.creator: Mandrak
images.subject: Podział cesarstwa po śmierci Teodozjusza, 395 n.e.
images.scope_and_date_limitations: Recommended large teaching map. Red west = Pars occidentalis; purple east = Pars orientis. AD 395 printed in map. Thin lines are Roman provinces; yellow dioceses; orange proconsular provinces, NOT modern borders. Latin labels; add Polish west/east explanations in slide text. No city markers: does not itself locate Rome/Constantinople. Modern schematic of administration after Theodosius, not creation of two culturally unrelated countries or the 117 extent. Province-level accuracy not independently audited.
images.modifications: No new pixel changes; exact download/reuse

images.creator: MapMaster; later revisions listed in inspected file history
images.subject: Najazdy i wędrówki ludów, 100–500 n.e.
images.scope_and_date_limitations: Modern schematic arrows over multiple centuries, NOT a single-year map and NOT evidence all movements were simultaneous. English names. Large labels include Western/Eastern Roman Empire, Rome, Constantinople, Carthage. Can support fall-of-West explanation but not precise migration routes/timing. Do not call everyone Germanic: Huns distinct. Inspected metadata cites Cornell/Matthews 1982 and Ermatinger 2004.
images.modifications: No new pixel changes; exact download/reuse

images.creator: Tataryn; subsequent file revisions listed in inspected file history
images.subject: Imperium za Trajana, 117 n.e.
images.scope_and_date_limitations: Modern historical reconstruction, NOT the 395 division. Red = Roman Empire; pink = client states, not provinces. Pink Caucasian/Bosporan clients must not be counted as Roman territory. Includes short-lived eastern conquests; not the stable extent under Hadrian. Many Latin/English place names; use large/fullscreen. Own-work map; all detailed borders have not been independently re-surveyed.
images.modifications: No new pixel changes; exact download/reuse

images.title: Wojny punickie (264–146 p.n.e.)
images.author: Krystian Chariza i zespół
images.verification: Downloaded ZPE original /res/ (not res-minimized); inspected original raster visually. RZYM, KARTAGINA, Sycylia all readable; complete legend and date range intact.
images.scope_warning: This is a synoptic map of ALL THREE Punic Wars (264–146 BCE), NOT territorial status in 218 BCE. Do not label as map of 218 BCE or second war only.
images.hannibal_route: Purple arrows: działania wojsk kartagińskich Hannibala (z datami), including Iberia–Pyrenees–Alps–Italy. Route dates visible include 219, 218 and 203 BCE; not exclusively 218.
territorial_legend: Burgundy: państwo rzymskie w 264 r. p.n.e.
Purple: posiadłości Kartaginy w 264 r. p.n.e.
Burgundy hatching: zdobycze Rzymu po I wojnie punickiej (Korsyka i Sardynia w 238 r. p.n.e.)
Light purple: zdobycze Kartaginy przed II wojną punicką
Light salmon diagonal hatching: zdobycze Rzymu po II wojnie punickiej
Salmon fill: zdobycze państwa rzymskiego przed III wojną punicką
Salmon horizontal hatching: zdobycze Rzymu po III wojnie punickiej
images.credit_line: Krystian Chariza i zespół, „Wojny punickie”, ZPE, CC BY 3.0. Bez zmian.
